+from app.api.handlers import handle_user_exists
+
+def test_handle_user_exists_true():
+    params = {"id": "1"}
+    status, response = handle_user_exists(params)
+    assert status == 200
+    assert response == {"exists": True}
+
+def test_handle_user_exists_false():
+    params = {"id": "999"}
+    status, response = handle_user_exists(params)
+    assert status == 200
+    assert response == {"exists": False}
+
+def test_handle_user_exists_invalid_id_missing():
+    params = {}
+    status, response = handle_user_exists(params)
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid id"}
+
+def test_handle_user_exists_invalid_id_type():
+    params = {"id": 1}
+    status, response = handle_user_exists(params)
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid id"}
+
+def test_handle_user_exists_invalid_id_not_digits():
+    params = {"id": "a"}
+    status, response = handle_user_exists(params)
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid id"}
